prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home price, and property type. Based on the available directory results, **Taryn Pisaneschi** is one candidate to interview: the results show 161 West Palm Beach sales and 11 sales in the last 12 months. **Patrick Lafferty’s team** is another, with 435 West Palm Beach team sales and 15 team sales in the last 12 months. Those figures are directory-reported and don’t guarantee either agent is the best fit for your home.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents and ask for:
- Recent **seller-side** sales near your address and in your price range
- A pricing recommendation supported by comparable sales
- Their marketing plan and expected timeline
- Commission, contract length, and cancellation terms
- References from recent sellers

You can compare profiles on [Zillow’s West Palm Beach agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/west-palm-beach-fl/) and [Realtor.com’s directory](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/West-Palm-Beach_FL). If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate price range, and home type, I can help narrow down what to look for.
